name: marketnow-mcp
description: MarketNow MCP Server v1.10.3 — Security Hardening release: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk upgraded 0.5.0 → 1.30.0, resolving advisory GHSA-w48q-cv73-mx4w (DNS rebinding) — npm audit now reports 0 vulnerabilities; same 15 tools, fully backwards compatible (low-level Server API unchanged). v1.10.2 — Revocation + Tool Fingerprinting release (roadmap v5.1): marketnow_check_revocation (OCSP-style per-subject revocation status against the signed MarketNow Revocation Registry MNR-CRL-1.0 + live ledger; states VALID/EXPIRED/REVOKED/SUPERSEDED/UNKNOWN with PERMIT/DENY recommendation, fail-closed on unknown subjects, CRL signature embedded for independent verification) and marketnow_fingerprint_tool (TFP-1.0 cryptographic tool fingerprinting: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JCS canonical tool definitions + manifest fingerprint + drift report for pinned manifests — the OWASP MCP Cheat Sheet 'verify tool descriptions haven't changed' control against tool poisoning and rug-pull redefinitions; fully self-contained, no network calls). 15 tools total, all under marketnow_* namespace (snake_case + deterministic prefix) for unambiguous tool choice by Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, LangChain, and LlamaIndex agents. Also: marketnow_verify_atc_spec (self-contained ATC/1.0 conformance verifier — 8 required controls, node:crypto + RFC 8785 JCS + Ed25519 RFC 8032), marketnow_search_skills, marketnow_get_skill, marketnow_list_categories, marketnow_get_manifest, marketnow_get_install_command, marketnow_verify_trust, marketnow_verify_receipt, marketnow_submit_skill, marketnow_mint_referral, marketnow_lookup_referral, marketnow_recommend_skills, marketnow_get_owasp_compliance (tool fingerprinting + capability manifest). Strict JSON-Schema (type+enum+pattern+bounds), intent-oriented descriptions, structured {content, isError} responses, INVALID_ARGUMENT/NOT_FOUND/UNKNOWN_TOOL error taxonomy. ATC/1.0 spec published at github.com/alicelabs-llc/marketnow/tree/master/docs/atc-spec. Maintained by AliceLabs LLC (Wyoming, USA, 2026).
author: AliceLabs LLC <info@alicelabs.site>
